Hundreds turn up for today's wellness walk, promoting the Chief Secretary department's theme 'Diversity', building stronger workplace relationships, promoting team bonding, staying active, respecting our differences, and supporting one another through our community strengths.

This government initiative encourages active, healthier lifestyle choices. Let us continue our journey toward a healthier and happier community.

title: Naoero Participates in Ministerial Meeting on UN Security Council Reform
excerpt: Deputy Minister for Foreign Affairs and Trade, the Honourable Russ Kun, attended the Ministerial Meeting of the L.69 Group and the African Union Committee of Ten (C-10) on 23 September 2026 at the Permanent Mission of India to the United...
content:
Deputy Minister for Foreign Affairs and Trade, the Honourable Russ Kun, attended the Ministerial Meeting of the L.69 Group and the African Union Committee of Ten (C-10) on 23 September 2026 at the Permanent Mission of India to the United Nations in New York.

He was accompanied by Ms Josie Ann Dongobir, First Secretary of the Permanent Mission of Naoero to the United Nations.

The meeting focused on advancing comprehensive reform of the United Nations Security Council to better reflect contemporary global realities and strengthen the representation of developing countries, Africa and other underrepresented groups.

For Naoero, meaningful representation of Small Island Developing States remains an important priority. Naoero supports expansion of the Security Council in both the permanent and non-permanent categories, including the L.69 proposal for a dedicated rotating non-permanent seat for SIDS.

Naoero will continue to advocate for a Security Council that is more representative, legitimate and responsive to the security challenges faced by small island nations, including the impacts of climate change on peace, stability and human security.

title: Naoero attends the FIPIC Foreign Ministers' Meeting
excerpt: Deputy Minister for Foreign Affairs and Trade, Russ Kun, and Deputy Minister for Foreign Investment, Timothy Ika, attended the Forum for India-Pacific Islands Cooperation (FIPIC) Foreign Ministers' Meeting on 23 September 2026. The meeting...
content:
Deputy Minister for Foreign Affairs and Trade, Russ Kun, and Deputy Minister for Foreign Investment, Timothy Ika, attended the Forum for India-Pacific Islands Cooperation (FIPIC) Foreign Ministers' Meeting on 23 September 2026.

The meeting was hosted by the Government of India at the Permanent Mission of India to the United Nations in New York and brought together representatives of India and Pacific Island countries to review progress since the Third FIPIC Summit held in Port Moresby in 2023.

Discussions focused on cooperation in healthcare, information and communications technology, agriculture, humanitarian assistance and disaster relief, capacity building and technical assistance, as well as cooperation through the India-UN Development Partnership Fund.

Delivering Naoero's national statement, Honourable Kun welcomed India's continued engagement with the Pacific and emphasised that the priority must now be the timely implementation of commitments. He highlighted Naoero's interest in healthcare support, including the proposed dialysis unit and sea ambulance, as well as cooperation in renewable energy, cybersecurity, agriculture and specialised training.

Naoero remains committed to working with India through FIPIC to translate regional commitments into practical and lasting benefits for the people of Naoero.

title: President Adeang meets Kuwait's Minister of Foreign Affairs
excerpt: His Excellency President David Adeang met with Kuwait's Minister of Foreign Affairs, H.E. Jarrah Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah, Assistant Foreign Minister H.E. Abdulaziz Saud Al-Qadfan, and Kuwait's Permanent Representative to the United...
content:
His Excellency President David Adeang met with Kuwait's Minister of Foreign Affairs, H.E. Jarrah Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah, Assistant Foreign Minister H.E. Abdulaziz Saud Al-Qadfan, and Kuwait's Permanent Representative to the United Nations, H.E. Ambassador Tareq M. A. M. Albanai, at the Kuwait UN Mission in New York on Wednesday, 23 September.

Discussions focused on further strengthening the relationship between Naoero and Kuwait and exploring support for development projects in Naoero. The two countries established diplomatic relations in 2013.

President Adeang was accompanied by Minister Eoe, Deputy Minister Gadabu, Ambassador Daniel and senior Naoero government officials.
author: Naoero Airlines
